definitions.explanation: The quality of speaking powerfully and persuasively. Also used figuratively to describe things that communicate something strongly without words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雄弁|ゆうべん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物語|ものがた}っている→物語る：18730_monogataru⟧。
examples.english: These numbers eloquently tell of the severity of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時|とき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Silence can sometimes convey feelings more eloquently than words.

notes:
USAGE:
{雄弁|ゆうべん} can describe a person's speaking ability or, more commonly in modern usage, things that powerfully communicate a message. The figurative use — {雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物語|ものがた}る→物語る：18730_monogataru⟧ (to tell eloquently) — is especially frequent.

The well-known proverb {雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧、⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|きん} ("Speech is silver, silence is gold") uses this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物語|ものがた}る→物語る：18730_monogataru⟧ (to tell eloquently; to speak volumes)
- {雄弁|ゆうべん}な⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧ (eloquent speech)
- {雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (eloquent speaker; orator)
- {雄弁|ゆうべん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧、⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|きん} (speech is silver, silence is gold)
